doc: The 2v2 tutorial (scripts/match/duo_tutorial.gd, briefs/TUTORIAL_2V2.md): you and a guide (Meeko, the Dawnfox) against two sparring bots in a walled ring. beats: in order; id names the pass condition in DuoTutorial._progress, need is how many times it must land, foes how the two rivals may act (still: stand and watch; strafe: move only; poke: move and shoot in short bursts, nothing else; hold: stand back for a breather; fight: everything but the ultimate; full: everything), guide what the guide does (wait: stands where she is and waits for you; follow: stays at your side and lets you do it; fight: fights on her own; focus: marks one rival and fights it; down: knocked down, waiting for you), key the action whose key cap the tip shows. say is the guide's line as the beat starts, nag the one she says when you stall (again every nag_s), done her line when it lands, tip the short line on screen. Tokens: %K the beat's key, %s your Boki's name, %A your right click's name, %N your E's name, %F interact, %G the guide's name, %1 and %2 the two rivals. barks: her lines for things that happen in the fight (a few seconds apart at most). skip: what she says when a beat passes itself after skip_s with no progress. foe_dmg: the share of their usual damage the rivals deal. poke_on/poke_off: s of a poking rival's burst and rest. knock_hold: s a knocked rival stays down before it is back at its corner, full health. daze_s: s into the capture beat the wild Boki trips over by itself if you have not knocked it out. done_hold: s the last line stands before the end card.

beats.say: Hi! I'm %G. Come over here, I don't bite.
beats.nag: Over here! I'm the one waving.
beats.done: Those two are %1 and %2. They lose for a living.

beats.say: Slide is faster than running. And you look great doing it.
beats.nag: Slide! Like you're late for something.

beats.say: %1 is napping on the job. Go wake him up.
beats.nag: Still asleep. Rude, honestly. Hit him!
%K. Trust me, it's the fun one.

beats.say: And your %N. That one's a crowd-pleaser.
Uh-oh, they're awake. When they shoot, slide out of the way!
I'm marking %2. Both of us, same one. That's the whole trick.
beats.nag: %2! The one with the red marker!

beats.say: Oh! A wild Boki wandered in. Knock it out, then hold %F on it.
beats.nag: Bonk it gently, then hold %F. It's basically a hug.
beats.dazed: It's dazed! Hold %F next to it, quick!
beats.tripped: My little sun bonked it for you. Your turn!
beats.done: Into your box! Be nice to it.

beats.say: Oof. I'm down! Stand on my wisp, I'll owe you one.
beats.nag: Still down here. Lovely view. Bit lonely.
beats.done: Back up! I totally meant to do that.

beats.say: Your bond is full. Press %K, you and %s, together!
beats.nag: %K! The big one! I've been waiting all day.
beats.done: Okay, WOW. That's the good stuff.

beats.say: That's everything. Now let's win one for real!
beats.nag: We've got this. One at a time, together.
beats.done: We won! You're ready for the real thing.

guide_knock: My little sun did most of that.
you_down: Up you get. Happens to me all the time.
Shake it off, I've got you.
foe_back: They always come back. It's kind of sweet.

skip: We'll come back to that. Probably.
Let's skip ahead. I won't tell.
Fine, moving on. This part's better anyway.
